1. Introduction

A height pairing on homologically trivial cycles is expected to satisfy arithmetic analogues of hard Lefschetz and Hodge–Riemann. Finiteness of integral height balls asks for additional arithmetic control. On a product of curves, these questions can be separated using its exact tensor Chow decomposition: the position of a Lefschetz string is geometric, its signed height is central, and its integral coefficients have one fixed denominator bound.

abstractHtml: For a product of pointed curves, the tensor Chow projectors turn arithmetic hard Lefschetz into an exact vanishing condition on the all-h1h^1h1 groups of its subproducts. A primitive sum-of-squares identity then reduces positivity and integral finite-height questions to the central degree. In that degree, a self-transpose Chow projector separates a Néron–Tate summand from a canonical Griffiths pairing. We prove that central integral Northcott is equivalent to injectivity of the algebraic Abel–Jacobi map and integral Northcott on this residual quotient. We also construct residual arithmetic regulators and prove criteria for the common integral lattice and for the fields of definition needed in a Northcott argument. The height statements concern a system satisfying the four explicit axioms below.
